dispatch.headline: Mother Freezes Family For Better Lighting
dispatch.body:
Seven members of the Osei family were admitted to the cold ward at Deep-Lanthorn Nine on Friday after being forced onto the unheated exterior hull for a matching-fleece holiday photo.

None wore pressure helmets.

Thandiwe Osei, who manages the waystation light-beacon, had spent three months weaving matching red garments for her children, grandchildren, and ninety-year-old mother. She insisted the living quarters were unsuitable for a proper portrait.

"The scrubber lamps make everyone look grey," Thandiwe said from her bunk, where both her feet were wrapped in blue heat-foam. "The starlight outside is far more flattering."

The family stood on the outer plating in deep vacuum for ninety seconds while Thandiwe adjusted the tripod legs. Her son-in-law lost two toes. Her mother's jaw froze mid-smile, requiring four hours under the warm lamps to unhook.

Nobody could scream.

Station medics confirmed that all seven family members are now stable, though three grandchildren cannot feel their ears.

The shutter froze shut before the sensor triggered, recording only a black frame and a burst of static.

Thandiwe remains undeterred by the injuries or the loss of the image.

"Next year we will use the solar array," she said, adjusting her drip line. "The contrast is much better."
dispatch.scene: A family in identical red knitted jumpers stands stiffly on the dark metal surface of a space station while a woman adjusts a camera tripod.
dispatch.premise: A family running an isolated deep-space waystation suffered widespread frostbite after the mother forced three generations onto the unheated exterior hull to capture a matching-sweater holiday photo.

brief.subject: a woman wearing a thick red knitted wool sweater, dark insulated work trousers, and heavy grey rubberized boots
brief.action: adjusting the locking clamp on a heavy camera tripod fixed to the deck plating
brief.setting: the dark, broad metal hull surface of a space station with six family members in matching red jumpers standing in a stiff row behind her
brief.light: hard, direct starlight from above casting sharp dark shadows across the hull plates
brief.materials: coarse red yarn, dark textured deck steel, matte composite tripod tubing, heavy rubber
brief.anomaly: a scuffed yellow utility carabiner attached to the tripod frame

quality.judge_reason: Perfectly skewers the universal insanity of family holiday photo ops with sharp quotes and a great final kicker.
quality.critique:
The original draft described the absurd premise in the headline rather than landing a distinct punchline.
The ending merely restated her stubbornness instead of recontextualising the failed photo as an actual sent product.
